The search for silence: Why delivery drones are creating a noise controversy

28 Oct 2026, 08:21 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Business Desk · Source: www.bbc.co.uk

1 min read

Key takeaways

Image: www.bbc.co.uk · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9; original source image

In this article
  1. The drone noise dilemma
  2. Technological solutions underway

The drone noise dilemma

As commercial drone deliveries expand, residents in areas like North Garland, Texas, are reporting significant distress over the persistent buzzing of overhead aircraft. Unlike standard traffic noise, the high-pitched whine of drone rotors is proving particularly intrusive to local communities. Acoustic experts suggest this sensitivity stems from the novelty and proximity of low-altitude flights.

Technological solutions underway

Industry players are responding to these concerns. Amazon reports using new propeller designs intended to halve perceived noise, while startups like Greenjets and Sharrow Engineering are developing shrouded propulsion systems and twisted blades to dampen sound. Despite these engineering advancements, experts warn that public complaints may rise as delivery fleets proliferate. Regulators, including the FAA, currently delegate the management of these community concerns to operators and local leaders.
